entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: A giant cockatrice at Sarraza in Almaaz, summoned by Porros and later bound in an Armageddon clock.

entities.name: Sarraza
entities.description: Place in Almaaz where the Beast of the Hours was bound beneath the mountain.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane on which the Beast of the Hours dwelt.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Mishra and Urza, during which the Beast was summoned.

entities.name: Porros
entities.description: A traitor who summoned the Beast, and who was cursed by Samor into a taloned sand wraith.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza whose armies the Beast decimated.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Mishra's brother, whom Mishra wished to threaten.

entities.name: Samor the Collector
entities.description: A songmage who helped bind the Beast and was killed by Porros.

entities.name: Circle of songmages
entities.description: Songmages called by Mishra to destroy the Beast.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: Place buried beneath the desert by Porros; its fall left nobody knowing how to release the Beast.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: A songmage who released the Beast during the Thaw and then banished it.

entities.name: Womba
entities.description: An orc killed by the Beast.

entities.name: Chimes
entities.description: Chimes that were destroyed when they vibrated too intensely.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: The period (c. 3050 AR) in which the Beast was released.

events.summary: Porros summons the giant cockatrice, which decimates Mishra's armies.
events.quote: the Dark Prince Porros summoned the giant cockatrice called the Beast of the Hours

events.summary: A discordant tone, sung by Porros, forces the songmages to bind the Beast instead; it is locked in an Armageddon clock beneath Mount Sarraza.
events.quote: The Beast of the Hours was locked into an Armageddon clock beneath Mount Sarraza .

events.summary: Porros kills Samor in a fight while Samor curses him into a taloned sand wraith; Porros buries Sumifa beneath the desert.
events.quote: Porros cut Samor's throat, while Samor cursed Porros into becoming a taloned sand wraith

events.summary: During the Thaw, Ogwater Rifkin releases the Beast with music and magical items, destroying the Chimes.
events.quote: the Beast of the Hours was released by the songmage Ogwater Rifkin

events.summary: The Beast kills the orc Womba before Ogwater banishes it from existence.
events.quote: The Beast of the Hours killed the orc Womba before Ogwater managed to use his renewed song magic to banish the creature from existence

relations.quote: the Dark Prince Porros summoned the giant cockatrice

relations.note: Killed the orc during the Thaw.
relations.quote: The Beast of the Hours killed the orc Womba

relations.note: Viewed Mishra as a false king.
relations.quote: whom Porros viewed as a false king
